title: The 10 Best Corded Rotary Tools
subtitle: Dremel and its rivals for cutting, sanding, engraving, polishing and grinding small parts, ranked from live Amazon data.
intro: A rotary tool spins small bits at up to 35,000 rpm or more to cut bolts, sand curves, engrave, polish and sharpen. We ranked 10 corded best-sellers on rating, review volume and features (electronic speed control that holds rpm under load, a keyless chuck, a flex shaft and a big accessory kit). Dremel's tools take the widest range of attachments; the budget kits pack in more bits for less. They run from about $22 for WEN's kits to $129 for Dremel's 4300.
data_source: Amazon product listings on the data_captured date. Prices, ratings and review counts change daily; check the listing before relying on a number.

avoid.name: HARDELL 1200W Flex Shaft Grinder, 30000RPM, 46pcs Flex Shaft Rotary Tool Kit
avoid.flag: 1200W claim; listing says not to bend the flex shaft
avoid.verdict: A hanging flex-shaft grinder sold on a power figure that doesn't fit the tool. At the same price, the Dremel 4000 is a proven rotary tool with real speed control.
reasons: It claims a 1200 W motor. That's 10 amps at 120 volts, about what a corded angle grinder draws, for a tool that spins carving and polishing bits.
The whole point of a flex-shaft tool is a shaft that bends, yet the listing warns that the flexible shaft 'must not be bent during use' or it will be irreversibly damaged.
The spec table lists the power source as 'Cordless Rotary Tool Pink' for a corded, pedal-controlled machine, so the listing's details can't be trusted.

buyers_guide.q: Do I need a Dremel, or is a budget kit fine?
buyers_guide.a: For occasional crafts and cleanup, a $22-40 kit works. Dremel's 4000 and 4300 add electronic speed control that holds rpm when you push on a bit, and the widest range of attachments. If you'll cut metal regularly, that matters.

High speeds (25,000-35,000 rpm) for cutting and grinding metal; low speeds (5,000-15,000 rpm) for polishing, plastics and wood carving, where high rpm melts or burns. A low minimum speed is as useful as a high maximum.

buyers_guide.q: What is a flex shaft for?
buyers_guide.a: A flex shaft moves the bit to a pen-sized handpiece on a cable, so you can engrave and carve with fine control while the motor hangs nearby. Hang the tool so the shaft runs in a gentle curve, not a sharp bend.
Collets grip one shank size each, so you swap collets for different bits. A 3-jaw keyless chuck takes any shank in its range without tools. Collets run truer; chucks are faster.

buyers_guide.q: What safety gear do I need?
buyers_guide.a: Eye protection always: cut-off wheels shatter. Use a dust mask for sanding and grinding, and keep loose sleeves and long hair clear of the bit.
